name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-google-custom-search
title: Google Custom Search MCP
description: MCP server for Google Custom Search: web and image search via a Programmable Search Engine.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CUSTOM_SEARCH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google Cloud API key with the Custom Search API enabled. Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CUSTOM_SEARCH_ENGINE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Programmable Search Engine id (cx). Tools accept a per-call engine_id override.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CUSTOM_SEARCH_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429, and 5xx/network — the API is idempotent GETs only).
